title: Malaysia KPKT TEDUH Property Developer Scraper Input

maxPages.title: Max API Pages to Fetch (30 Developers per Page)
maxPages.description: Number of pages to fetch from KPKT TEDUH /api/developer-swasta (the actor asks for 30 developers per page, with all their licensed housing projects). The run stops early at the last page reported by the API; on 2 Nov 2026 the API reported 6,548 developers = 219 pages.

maxItems.title: Max Project Records to Output
maxItems.description: Maximum number of developer-project records to push to the dataset (Free-tier Apify runs are capped at 25 results).

searchKeyword.title: Optional Developer Name or Code
searchKeyword.description: Optional developer name to search for, passed to the KPKT API (digits only = search by developer code). Leave empty for all developers.
